annotations.title: Apartment rent and jeonse trend in a Korean area

description: Month by month median apartment rent, deposit and jeonse deposit in an area of South Korea for each of the most recent months (up to 12), from reported contracts (MOLIT). Fits questions about whether rent is rising or falling in an area.

area.description: A place in South Korea: "Korea" for the whole country, a province or city ("Seoul", "Busan", "Gyeonggi"), or a district, city or county ("Mapo-gu", "Gangnam", "Suwon-si", "마포구").

province.description: Optional. The province or city the area is in, when its name exists in more than one ("Jung-gu" is in Seoul, Busan and other cities).

name: housing_trend
